mn145:5.32: The Comy. explains that these were bhikkhus who, disgusted by the body through over-zealous practice of the meditation on foulness, took their own lives — an incident referred to in the Vinaya (Pārājika III), for which such bhikkhus were blamed by the Buddha. But a few took their lives because of the torturing pain of disease, and having attained arahantship immediately before death, were not blamed.
